updates.changesSummary: [Certificados] Esta actualización incluye una carga actualizada de certificado raíz de confianza. Está destinado a dispositivos que no reciben actualizaciones actuales de la lista de certificados de confianza (CTL), incluidas las actualizaciones de la lista de certificados que no son de confianza. Esto incluye dispositivos en entornos desconectados, dispositivos que no pueden acceder al servicio de actualización de certificados de Microsoft y dispositivos donde las actualizaciones automáticas de CTL están deshabilitadas. Para obtener más información, consulte Certificados y confianza en Windows .
updates.resolvedIssuesSummary: [Almacenamiento] Corregido: Esta actualización soluciona un problema que afecta a los discos administrados de E/S de múltiples rutas (MPIO). Los discos afectados podrían desconectarse inesperadamente o mostrar C0000010 de error en la pestaña Detalles de Administrador de dispositivos. Después de instalar esta actualización, los discos iSCSI administrados por MPIO permanecen en línea y ya no muestran este error. [Audio (problema conocido)] Corregido: Esta actualización soluciona un problema por el que algunos dispositivos de clase de audio USB 1.0 podrían no iniciar o producir audio.
updates.knownIssuesSummary: Microsoft no está al tanto de ningún problema con respecto a esta actualización.

updates.changesSummary: [Date and Time] This update adjusts daylight saving time (DST) rules for Cuba for the extended 2026-2027 DST period. Cuba remains on UTC-04:00 and doesn't observe the November 2026 and March 2027 transitions. It returns to UTC-05:00 in November 2027 and resumes its regular seasonal schedule in 2028. For the latest DST and time zone guidance, see the Daylight Saving Time & Time Zone Blog . [Printing] - Fixed: Adding a printer published in Active Directory through Settings > Bluetooth & devices > Printers & scanners > Add device might fail with error 87, "The parameter is incorrect." This issue was introduced by the October 2026 update and does not generally affect existing printers or printing. [Windows PowerShell] This update strengthens security for PowerShell script signing and signature verification by introducing stricter encoding validation. As a result, scripts containing invalid UTF-8 encoding might fail signature validation, even if they were previously accepted. To resolve this issue, review the affected scripts, save them using valid UTF-8 encoding with a byte order mark (BOM), and sign them again. For further guidance, see Encoding Guidance for Signed PowerShell Scripts .
updates.resolvedIssuesSummary: [Windows Deployment Services] Fixed: After installing this security update, the Import-WdsInstallImage cmdlet requires administrator privileges. Attempts to run the cmdlet as a non-administrator fail with an ACCESS_DENIED error. [Remote Desktop] Fixed: The “Specify thumbprints of certificates representing trusted .rdp publishers” policy could not be configured successfully through Microsoft Intune. Fixed: Remote Desktop shadow connections might fail with an “Unspecified error” on Windows Server 2016 and Windows Server 2012 R2 after installing the October 14, 2026, update. [Remote Desktop Web Access] Fixed: RD Web Access might fail to load and display “Unable to display RD Web Access” in Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome when XSLT is disabled by browser policy. RD Web Access pages are now rendered on the server and no longer depend on browser XSLT support. To learn more, see KB5130994: RD Web Access fails to load when XSLT is disabled in Microsoft Edge or Google Chrome . [Exchange Server] This update fixes an issue that affects on-premises Exchange servers. The issue might prevent signing in to Outlook on the web (OWA), cause email messages to remain in the Outlook Outbox without being delivered, or prevent Exchange from accessing mailboxes during mailbox replication.
updates.knownIssuesSummary: Users might be unable to sign in to OWA or send emails on Exchange Server Symptoms: After installing this update, some on-premises Exchange servers might experience issues accessing or sending email. Users might be unable to sign in to Outlook on the web (OWA), or email messages sent from Outlook might remain in the Outbox and not be delivered. Additionally, Exchange might experience issues accessing mailboxes during mailbox replication. In some affected configurations, Exchange Server OWA might fail with an error MapiExceptionMdbOffline: Unable to make connection to the server. (hr=0x80004005, ec=1142) with Event ID 1006 logged in the application log. Another reported symptom is growing email queues. Installing the October 2026 Exchange server security updates isn’t required for these issues to occur. Resolution This issue is resolved in Windows updates released on and after November 10, 2026 such as (KB5131291) . We recommend you install the latest Windows update for your device as it contains important improvements and issue resolutions, including this one. USB Audio Class 1.0 devices with error Code 10 or no output Symptoms After installing the September 8, 2026, Windows security update, some USB Audio Class 1.0 devices might fail to start or produce audio. Affected devices might experience one or more of the following symptoms: The device displays an error in Device Manager: "This device cannot start (Code 10).” No audio output. Volume controls are unresponsive or remain at zero. Sound settings are unresponsive or unavailable. Some devices might function in standard stereo configurations but fail when using multichannel audio features, including 8-channel or 3D audio modes. Some customers have reported that they're able to restore audio in these cases by switching to 2-channel mode. This issue is limited to USB Audio Class 1.0 devices. Resolution The symptoms experienced on devices using 8-channel or 3D audio modes are addressed in the out-of-band (OOB) update released on September 14, 2026, (KB5129239) . The remaining symptoms are addressed in (KB5131291) .
